original.statement: ApplicationSets are no longer requeued when their status changes, preventing unnecessary reconciliation cycles.

decision.reason: [ev-35fad7c873dd] is a bug-fix changelog line saying ApplicationSets are no longer requeued when their status changes. That is a runtime reconciliation change with no configuration change, so behavior-changed is the right change type. The name "appset-status-requeue" is a short kebab-case name built only from the line's own words. The text only gives the commit scope "appset" and never names a controller binary, so leaving out a component is correct.
